The model predicts that email-1 raises customer 6958's probability of converting by about 9.23 percentage points.

scikit-learn, xgboost and lightgbm aren't installed here and pip isn't available. I wrote a small gradient-boosted tree regressor in numpy instead: 100 trees, depth 2, learning rate 0.05. I used a T-learner on the training data: one boosted model for customers who got em1 and one for those who didn't.

For customer 6958, the model predicts a conversion probability of about 19.83% with em1 and about 10.61% without it. The difference is the 9.23%.

This figure depends on my hyperparameters and my own implementation. A different boosting library or settings would give a somewhat different value.

ANSWER: 9.23%
